canonical_name: Incident Response Plans and Cybersecurity Plans Not Maintained
description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans are not established and maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Continuous improvement and process optimization teams Security testing and assessment functions Organizations conducting lessons learned activities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for outdated or non-existent incident response plans, lack of plan distribution to relevant stakeholders, missing regular plan reviews and updates, or absence of plan testing and improvement cycles based on lessons learned.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
